question:
In the following probability distribution, the value of p is:

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|} \hline X & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ \hline P(X) & p & p & 0.3 & 2p \\ \hline \end{array}$$
explanation:
**Step 1:** Use the fundamental property of probability distributions that the sum of all individual probabilities must equal exactly 1 [cite: 1099].
**Step 2:** Set up the algebraic equation adding up the values from the given data distribution table: $p + p + 0.3 + 2p = 1 \implies 4p + 0.3 = 1$ [cite: 1099].
**Step 3:** Solve for $p$: $4p = 0.7 \implies p = \frac{0.7}{4} = \frac{7}{40}$.
